locations.label: Turbine workbench
locations.description: Before leaving Bus Depot, take the mannequin beside the central sign, the fan on the seats and the model-plane tail near the payphones. Carry one part at a time to the workbench in the starting room. Everyone can take a Turbine from the finished bench. Deploy it at the side door to leave without buying the main door; pick it back up after passing through. A broken Turbine can be replaced at this bench. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Build and activate power
locations.description: At the fourth stop, buy the small shed door and drop through its floor. In the white underground room, collect the electrical panel, switch handle and severed hand from the floor/railings and assemble them at the workbench. Turn the completed switch on. Wait for the electrical sequence and dialogue before leaving via the upper catwalk; a Turbine can open the exit gate. Avoid the open pit. For Maxis, wait for his instruction, then switch power off. For Richtofen or ordinary setup, leave it on. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Town bank / Pack-a-Punch route
locations.description: In Town’s bank, use explosives to open both vault doors. The passage beyond the second vault should lead downstairs. A closed metal wall means the Power Station Turbine is not supplying the door: return and replace it. Downstairs, find the machine casing, battery and stool/table in the corridors and carry them to the far workbench one at a time. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: First Mystery Box
locations.description: The bus travels Bus Depot → Diner → Farm → Power Station → Town → Bus Depot. It does not wait for your setup to finish. At Diner, the MP5 is a dependable refillable weapon and the first Mystery Box is outside. At Farm, open the farmhouse for the weapon fridge and reach the barn for Double Tap. Save enough for the Power Station shed and Town’s Jugger-Nog building. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
